svg.title: Beltline machine catalogue
svg.desc: One of each machine kind in the Beltline kit, joined by belts. Inserter arms load and unload the stores, a diverter flap picks a route, a hash pointer finds a bucket, and an LRU moves a node to the front of its list.
svg.text: Every kit machine with sample values. Illustrative, not a recording.

g.text: 1/9 an inserter lifts the item off the rack and onto the belt
2/9 ring buffer: c lands in the tail sector and the tail arm turns
3/9 hash map: h(k3) = 2, so the pointer drops to bucket 2
4/9 LRU: get(a) finds node 0 through the map and moves a to the MRU end
5/9 the tokenizer cuts a number and hands it to the branch
6/9 branch: kind == num, so the flap swings to the upper route
7/9 the press renders a glyph and an inserter drops it on the plate
8/9 the next token is an operator
9/9 branch: else, so the flap swings down and the lock's gate turns
